headline: Agricultural diesel still 60% more expensive than before the war, and fishing diesel 86% higher
summary: Government aid has held down professional diesel prices, but agricultural fuel remains 60% more expensive than before the war in Iran. Fishing diesel is 86% higher.
why: Diesel is a major input cost for farming and fishing, so fuel price levels affect margins and food production costs in Spain.

original_headline: El gasóleo agrícola sigue un 60 % más caro que antes de la guerra y el pesquero, un 86 % más alto
